AC AMENDMENT (plan-review F4 minor):
- Rename test file from test-claude-safe-multiple-sub-prs.sh to test-worktree-removal-guards-e2e.sh (signals cross-script scope per project convention).
- The test path is mentioned in the story DD as test-claude-safe-multiple-sub-prs.sh; record the rename rationale in T5 commit message.
- Test must mock gh via PATH override (NOT bash function override) — see T1 AC amendment.

- [ ] Test file at the new path
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards-e2e.sh
- [ ] Test verifies 3-tier enumeration sees both main PR (--head) and sub-PRs (--base)
  Verify: grep -qE '\-\-head.*<|\-\-base.*<' tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards-e2e.sh
